buildReceipt.scope: Input/artifact receipt after successful Gradle build; verify again before launch and after the study. Not a replacement for original outcome verification.

checks: Four current-code source runs independently audited; only fully visible correct proposals curated from original reference-box pixels. All source labels and original bytes fixed before evaluation.
Four current-code source runs independently audited; only fully visible correct proposals curated from original reference-box pixels. All source labels and original bytes fixed before evaluation.

Twelve separated evaluation runs (three methods × four windows), 1140 original frame outcomes independently scored. No automatic admissions; candidate/control share the same frozen source references. Default unchanged.

Actual reference-selection controls, same-target declaration, stopped prefix/resume, complete Java reference bundle including donor pixels and explicit desktop export-size refusal, and four independent overlays exercised. Native world unchanged.

Owned-process crash and cold reopen preserve exact completed-state bytes and timestamp with zero observation writes. All16 runs, labels, source examples and outcomes reverified; changed donor pixels refuse audit/export, restored originals reverify.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Real camera recording.
dataset.title: OTB tiger2-59 partial leaf cover and left-edge clipping

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. partial leaf cover and left-edge clipping. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. partial cover by caliper. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

retained.scope: Post-evaluation curation from independent target boxes and declared visibility. Partial, uncertain and incorrect proposals are excluded. Rebuilt numeric appearances are portable; original project/source/audit are required to reverify. No semantic identity certification, automatic model training or feedback into the measured tracking run.

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. partial tree occlusion and return. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

retained.scope: Post-evaluation curation from independent target boxes and declared visibility. Partial, uncertain and incorrect proposals are excluded. Rebuilt numeric appearances are portable; original project/source/audit are required to reverify. No semantic identity certification, automatic model training or feedback into the measured tracking run.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Rendered/animated source, not real-world camera footage.
dataset.title: OTB bird1-97 rendered cloud disappearance and return; not real-world camera footage

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. rendered cloud disappearance and return; not real-world camera footage. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Real camera recording.
dataset.title: OTB tiger2-155 later camera partial cover

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera partial cover. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Real camera recording.
dataset.title: OTB tiger2-155 later camera partial cover

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera partial cover. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera cover and return. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Real camera recording.
dataset.title: OTB box-535 later camera cover and return

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera cover and return. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

referenceMemory137.scope: Independent reference boxes and fully visible source annotations; original evidence reverified. Same-object declaration is supplied by the operator, not a semantic identity proof. No target predictions admitted.
referenceMemory137.declaration: Same labelled box target in a later non-overlapping window; operator declaration, not semantic identity proof.

reference137.scope: Frozen provenance and consecutive recovery checks. Independent target/visibility labels in the enclosing audit determine correctness; internal confidence is not identity proof.

appearance135.scope: Motion-cycle conditions are not identity truth. Separate labels score each admission and bank recovery; unlabelled/uncertain examples remain unknown. Initial seed is excluded from learned-example counts. Historical evidence retains its original source and code identity.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Real camera recording.
dataset.title: OTB box-535 later camera cover and return

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera cover and return. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Real camera recording.
dataset.title: OTB david3-153 later camera tree cover and return

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera tree cover and return. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Real camera recording.
dataset.title: OTB david3-153 later camera tree cover and return

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera tree cover and return. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera tree cover and return. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Rendered/animated source, not real-world camera footage.
dataset.title: OTB bird1-193 later rendered cloud transitions

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later rendered cloud transitions. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Rendered/animated source, not real-world camera footage.
dataset.title: OTB bird1-193 later rendered cloud transitions

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later rendered cloud transitions. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later rendered cloud transitions. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.
